newsitem.title: UK: Ionica says shares priced at 390 pence.
newsitem.headline: Ionica says shares priced at 390 pence.

text.p: British telephone operator Ionica Plc said on Friday it was offering 40 million shares priced at 390 pence each to raise about 147 million stg.
Ionica, which announced its public offer details, said the offer would value the company at about 640 million stg.
The public offer would value the company at 640 million stg, Ionica said.
None of the existing shareholders is selling shares in the offering, the company said.
The holders of warrants had exercised conditionally on the closing of the offering, warrants over 8.4 million ordinary shares at an exercise price of 275 pence per share.
The exercise of these warrants will raise additional proceeds to Ionica of about 23.2 million stg.
The ordinary shares sold in the offering represent about 24 percent of the enlarged issued ordinary share capital of Ionica.
Dealings in the shares will commence on the London Stock Exchange and on Nasdaq on a conditional basis at 1330 GMT on Friday.
The closing of the offering is expected to take place on July 25, 1997.
